n-k-k10-04.title: One notice, two neighbours
n-k-k10-04.topic: Summarize formal notice without losing its limits
n-k-k10-04.goal: Find summary line wey change time limit for notice, then rewrite notice for neighbour group chat and as spoken reminder to elderly neighbour, keeping date, hours and building exact.
n-k-k10-04.material:
Management office put up notice. You live in 101동.

[단수 안내]
배관 점검 공사로 10월 25일 토요일 오전 9시부터 오후 2시까지 101동 전 세대의 물이 나오지 않습니다. 공사가 일찍 끝나면 물이 먼저 나올 수 있습니다. 단수 전에 필요한 물을 미리 받아 두시기 바라며, 공사 후 처음 나오는 물은 누런색일 수 있으니 잠시 틀어 둔 뒤 사용하시기 바랍니다.
n-k-k10-04.thinking.1: Choose suitable way of speaking for each listener

n-k-k10-04.s.s1.hint.0: Read notice and list facts (when, where, wetin to do). Then compare each summary with your list.
n-k-k10-04.s.s1.hint.1: Look for phrase wey make time longer, shorter or less exact than notice.

n-k-k10-04.s.s2.prompt: Write short message (2-3 sentences) for neighbours group chat in Korean, friendly 해요체. Keep date, hours, building and water advice exact.
n-k-k10-04.s.s2.hint.0: List four facts wey must remain: when, until when, who e affect, wetin to do first.
n-k-k10-04.s.s2.hint.1: Rewrite each one in friendly 해요체 and change stiff notice language to chat style.

n-k-k10-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: I keep advice about storing water?
n-k-k10-04.s.s3.prompt: You meet elderly neighbour for elevator. Say main point in one or two Korean spoken sentences, respectfully (honorific). Keep day, hours and advice.
n-k-k10-04.s.s3.hint.0: First address neighbour respectfully (어르신, 할머니, 할아버지 ...).
n-k-k10-04.s.s3.hint.1: Use -(으)세요 or -(으)시- for wetin neighbour suppose do, and keep hours brief.
n-k-k10-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Would I talk like this to older person wey I respect?
n-k-k10-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Neighbour fit act based on this alone (day, hours, prepare water)?

n-k-k10-01.title: Who talk am, and how strong?
n-k-k10-01.topic: Reported speech: speaker and strength of claim
n-k-k10-01.goal: Compare student's summary with original hearing record, find lines wey misreport speaker, name type of change, and rewrite one line accurately.
n-k-k10-01.material:
A school newspaper student summarised a public hearing. Below are the speakers' exact words and then the student's summary.

[간담회 발언 기록] 주제: 전통시장 주차장 유료화
박 시장: "내년 3월부터 시범 운영을 검토하고 있습니다. 아직 확정된 것은 아닙니다."
김 상인회장: "유료화되면 손님이 줄어들까 걱정입니다. 첫 30분은 무료로 해 주셨으면 합니다."
이 교수: "다른 도시에서는 유료화 후 주차 회전율이 높아졌다는 연구가 있습니다. 다만 상인 매출에 미친 영향은 도시마다 달랐습니다."

n-k-k10-01.s.s1.hint.0: Compare claim in line with the person's exact words: same claim and speaker?
n-k-k10-01.s.s1.hint.1: If line seem to match, put am beside the record sentence and compare word by word.
n-k-k10-01.s.s1.hint.2: Line 2 turn merchant leader worry (“줄어들까 걱정입니다”) into sure prediction (“단언했다”). Line 5 give professor research comment to mayor. Lines 1, 3, 4, 6 match.

n-k-k10-01.s.s2.prompt: Describe problem for each faulty line in one phrase before looking options.
n-k-k10-01.s.s2.hint.0: For each option decide whether e happen for one line you choose or none.
n-k-k10-01.s.s2.hint.1: One remark credit to wrong speaker.
n-k-k10-01.s.s2.o.b: Both faulty lines keep numbers (3월, 30분); distortion dey somewhere else.
n-k-k10-01.s.s2.r.b: A worry report as certain prediction. 3 30 월 분
n-k-k10-01.s.s2.o.d: The request for 30 free minutes report as request (“요청했다”) for line 3, and that correct.
n-k-k10-01.s.s2.r.d: One line credit professor research remark to mayor; the other make “걱정입니다” sound like certain outcome. 30 3 요청했다
n-k-k10-01.s.s2.explain: Rewrite faulty line about 상인회장 so e report wetin he say without distortion. Write Korean (news style like -다고 말했다) or English. 걱정입니다
n-k-k10-01.s.s3.prompt: Start sentence with person named in record, then state wetin that person feel or ask. 상인회장 다고 말했다
n-k-k10-01.s.s3.hint.0: Choose verb or ending wey fit “I worry that...” instead of “e go happen.”

n-k-k10-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Could 상인회장 read my sentence and say, “Yes, na wetin I talk”?
n-k-k10-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Use possibility form instead of 걱정. 상인회장
n-k-k10-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Head of merchants' association said e worry say fewer customers fit come. 걱정
n-k-k10-01.s.s3.modelNote.2: Which practice times pass every rule?

n-k-k10-02.title: Notice with exception: find all valid choices
n-k-k10-02.topic: Read clubroom notice with deadline, lunch break, weekend closing, and exam-period exception; find 3 practice slots on different dates following every rule, then request one in Korean.
n-k-k10-02.goal:
Today na 10월 10일, 월요일. Your band wan book clubroom today.
[Clubroom use notice]
1. Dem accept request until 3 days before use date.
2. Use time na 10 a.m. to 8 p.m., and one team fit use maximum 3 hours each time.
3. From 12 p.m. to 1 p.m. na lunch, so no use.
4. Door no open Saturday or Sunday.
5. But for exam period 10월 17일-19일, you no fit use am.
Band friend's text: “Our performance na 22nd, so we must finish practice by 21st. Each practice must last at least 2 hours.”
n-k-k10-02.material:
Today is 10월 10일, 월요일. Your band wants to book the club room today.

[동아리방 사용 안내]
1. 사용 신청은 사용일 3일 전까지 받습니다.
2. 사용 시간은 오전 10시부터 오후 8시까지이며, 한 팀이 한 번에 쓸 수 있는 시간은 3시간 이내입니다.
3. 낮 12시부터 오후 1시까지는 점심시간이므로 사용할 수 없습니다.

5. 단, 시험 기간인 10월 17일부터 19일까지는 사용할 수 없습니다.

밴드 친구의 문자: "우리 공연이 22일이라 21일까지는 연습을 끝내야 해요. 연습은 한 번에 2시간 이상 해야 하고요."

n-k-k10-02.s.s2.ok.c4: That date dey inside exam period.

n-k-k10-03.title: Rules with exception: what fact decides the case?
n-k-k10-03.topic: Find the one missing fact wey decide refund request under rule with exception, state wetin already clear, and politely ask for missing fact in Korean.
n-k-k10-03.goal:
Shop refund rules and customer request.
[Refund notice]
1. If you apply within 7 days from purchase, dem go refund.
2. Goods wey dem open or use no fit refund.
3. But if product get defect, dem go refund within 30 days from purchase whether package open or used or not.
[Order] 1 wireless earphone / purchase date: 10월 3일
Today na 10월 12일. Customer: “The earphone no good as I expect. Please refund me.”
n-k-k10-03.material:
A shop's refund rules and a customer's request.

[환불 안내]
1. 구매일로부터 7일 이내에 신청하시면 환불해 드립니다.
2. 포장을 뜯었거나 사용한 상품은 환불이 되지 않습니다.
3. 단, 상품에 불량이 있는 경우에는 구매일로부터 30일 이내에 포장이나 사용 여부와 상관없이 환불해 드립니다.

[주문 내역] 무선 이어폰 1개 / 구매일: 10월 3일
오늘은 10월 12일입니다. 손님: "이어폰이 생각보다 별로예요. 환불해 주세요."
n-k-k10-03.thinking.0: No assume facts wey no dey given.
n-k-k10-03.thinking.1: Answer only as far as facts allow.
n-k-k10-03.prereq.1: You be shop clerk. Which ONE missing fact go change whether refund possible? 단 으 경우 Knows 단 (exception) and -(으)ㄴ 경우
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.prompt: First work out how many days pass since purchase and compare with first rule.
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.hint.0: Then find rule wey fit still help customer and check wetin e require.
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.hint.1: Whether customer pay by card or cash.
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.o.a: Whether customer pay by card or cash.
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.r.a: Di rules no talk how customer pay.
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.o.b: Whether earphones still seal inside package.
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.r.b: 7-day limit don pass, so sealed package alone no qualify for refund, and rule 3 no even talk about package.
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.r.d: Order record already show date of purchase, and rules no ask for receipt.
n-k-k10-03.s.s1.explain: If you count from 10월 3일, today na di 9th day, so rule 1 no longer apply. Only rule 3 fit still give refund, and e depend on whether product get fault.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.prompt: Based only on wetin we know now, wetin clerk fit correctly tell customer?
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.hint.0: Separate wetin facts don settle from wetin still open.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.hint.1: Check each choice for fact wey case never mention, or rule wey e leave out.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.o.a: Refund possible, because request dey within 7 days.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.r.a: 10월 3일 to 10월 12일 na 9 days, wey pass 7-day limit.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.o.b: Refund because of changing mind don pass di limit, but faulty product still qualify.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.o.c: Refund no possible anyhow, because 7 days don pass.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.r.c: This ignore rule 3, wey allow 30 days if product get fault.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.o.d: Refund possible only if package still unopened.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.r.d: Unopened package matter only within 7 days; after that, rules no allow refund for unopened product.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.o.e: Refund no possible, because package probably don open.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.r.e: Case no talk say dem open package; na guess.
n-k-k10-03.s.s2.explain: Clerk fit tell customer wetin follow from facts: no refund just because person no like product after 7 days, but answer fit change if product get fault.
n-k-k10-03.s.s3.prompt: Reply customer for Korean politely. Say 7-day limit don pass for refund because dem change mind, then ask di one thing you still need to know before deciding.
n-k-k10-03.s.s3.hint.0: First, briefly and politely give reason from first rule.
n-k-k10-03.s.s3.hint.1: Then read di three rules again and ask about di fact wey case never give.
n-k-k10-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: I explain why answer no be yes yet?
n-k-k10-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: My question ask for di one fact wey go decide di case?

n-k-k10-05.title: Di ‘yes’ wey mean no
n-k-k10-05.topic: Answer negative question: 네 and 아니요
n-k-k10-05.goal: Change how you understand bare 네 after negative question as dialogue show misunderstanding, choose clearer answer, then fix misunderstanding in Korean.
n-k-k10-05.material: You work for company. Your department head (부장님) ask about tomorrow meeting. Both of una speak politely.
n-k-k10-05.thinking.0: Notice say short answer fit mean two things
n-k-k10-05.thinking.1: Change interpretation when other person reaction show
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.prompt: Read each part and choose most likely meaning before continuing.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.hint.0: Use only lines wey you don read so far to decide.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.hint.1: Think about wetin speaker fit dey agree with: question as asked, or facts?
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.0.after: For standard Korean, bare 네 agree with question as asked (‘네, 안 가요’), so a na normal meaning. Speaker used to English ‘yes’ fit mean b. Either way, bare 네 no tell listener which one.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Bare 네 no show hesitation; undecided answer go use words like ‘글쎄요’ or ‘아직요.’
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.0.o.d: I dey ask you question back.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Plain 네 no ask anything; tone must rise and question must use words.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Both a and d fit, but 나 immediate 아니요 and emphasis point more to a: person hear bare 네 as ‘not going’ even though 나 mean ‘yes, I am going.’
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.1.o.a: 부장님 hear 네 as ‘not going’; 나 mean ‘yes, I dey go.’
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: 부장님 hear 네 as ‘going,’ and 나 really no dey go.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Na last line say 가요 and 갈 거예요, so 나 dey go.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.1.o.c: 부장님 and 나 disagree about meeting date.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.1.o.d: 나 change mind after 부장님 offer to speak for am.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Next time negative question come, which answer style go avoid this problem?
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Repeat verb with no or yes to state fact directly, so listener no need guess wetin 네 refer to.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Answer 네 and explain only later if listener look confused.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Misunderstanding don already happen at first 네; later explanation fix am instead of prevent am.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Volume no change fact say 네 fit sound like you agree with question or with facts.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Always answer 아니요, no matter question.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Always saying 아니요 go give wrong answer whenever real answer na say you no dey go.
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Say 네 or 아니요 and repeat verb: ‘네, 안 가요’ or ‘아니요, 가요.’
n-k-k10-05.s.s1.reflect: Bare 네 or 아니요 after negative question (‘안 가세요?’) attach to whole question, no be facts only, so people fit hear am two opposite ways. Add verb (‘아니요, 가요’) to prevent misunderstanding.
n-k-k10-05.s.s2.prompt: Right after misunderstanding, send short polite Korean message to 부장님 saying you mean say you ARE going, and say sorry for confusion.
n-k-k10-05.s.s2.hint.0: Address 부장님 and briefly apologize for confusion.
n-k-k10-05.s.s2.hint.1: State fact with verb (wetin you go do tomorrow), no be bare answer word.
n-k-k10-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: My message clearly say say I dey go?
n-k-k10-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: I state fact with verb instead of bare 네?
n-k-k10-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: My apology polite and not too long?
